newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Repco in timber deal with Chase.
newsitem.headline: Repco in timber deal with Chase.

text.p: Malaysian timber company Repco Holdings Bhd said on Monday it had signed an agreement to sell timber to construction company Chase Perdana Bhd for its projects.

"Chase Perdana has appointed Repco as the main supplier of timber and timber related materials to current and future construction projects undertaken or to be undertaken by Chase Perdana," said Repco in a statement issued to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Repco said the agreement gave the company "the first option to supply all the timber used in the works to be undertaken by (Chase Perdana)".
The price of the timber would be subject to prevailing market prices, said Repco.
Repco did not mention the tenure of the agreement.

The agreement would ensure "long term demand for its timber-related downstream products", said Repco. The agreement would also "secure a stable source of these products for (Chase's) construction needs".
